# Later B discovery metadata

Privacy-reviewed subset of public GitHub run metadata, retained read-only from historical
series `9f5732bf0d63400381f463243184af6d`, B run `42506013197`, first attempt.
Source: preserved `0057-B-abort-stable-raw`, SHA-256 `4d0fe524c71387019976f819c212483e55f3eb285bba783f3a5c9021df7b816a`.
The original source was `44c9301ce8f0eebdb3d5a7f72fac477eae2bb264`.

Only fields needed by the existing identity/window checks are retained: public IDs, actor
identities, repository names, canonical run URL, source/ref/event/workflow and timestamps.
No credentials, headers, signed URLs, logs or unrelated repository/account fields are copied.
The reduced file is generated evidence from the GitHub REST run endpoint, without new HTTP;
metadata facts are retained for regression, not redistributed external implementation code.
Authored minimization/test harness: MPL-2.0, redistributable. No external source was copied.

This is later preserved stable metadata after natural completion. It is NOT the missing
first refused B response, supplies no original refusal cause, and cannot resume or requalify
the historical series. Historical status remains ABORTED / INCONCLUSIVE, cause UNKNOWN.
